description.value:
You've learned to slip past an opponent's guard with either quick reflexes or a sharp mind. Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

A number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, when you make an attack roll using Dexterity you may add half your Intelligence modifier to it; alternatively, when making an attack roll using Intelligence, you may add half your Dexterity modifier instead. This pool of uses refreshes after a long rest.

Separately, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you may treat an effect you control that calls for a Dexterity saving throw as calling for an Intelligence saving throw instead, or one that calls for an Intelligence saving throw as calling for a Dexterity saving throw instead. This pool of uses also refreshes after a long rest.
